caption_en:
Perfect happiness: 100. Israel: 72.

The World Happiness Report 2026 asks people to rate their life from 0 (worst possible) to 10 (best possible). Israel: 7.19, 8th of 147 countries.

What's in the gap?
• Prices: 4th highest of the 38 OECD countries (OECD 2025).
• Poverty: 20.7% of Israelis (National Insurance Institute).
• The war: Israel was 5th in 2024, now 8th.

Zoom out, same scale (x10): 🇮🇱 Israel 72, 🇦🇪 UAE 68, 🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia 68, 🇰🇼 Kuwait 65, 🇹🇷 Turkey 53, 🇮🇷 Iran 52, 🇯🇴 Jordan 45, 🇪🇬 Egypt 39. Last in the world: Afghanistan, 14.

Honest catch: the UAE and Saudi Arabia are only 4 points behind.

We're not perfect. But miserable? We're closer to a happy life than anyone around us.

Send this to a critic.
caption_he:
אושר מושלם: 100. ישראל: 72, מקום 8 בעולם.
בפער: יוקר מחיה (מקום 4 מתוך 38 במדינות ה־OECD), עוני (20.7%), והמלחמה: ב־2024 היינו במקום 5.
זום אאוט: האמירויות וסעודיה 68, כווית 65, טורקיה 53, איראן 52, ירדן 45, מצרים 39. במקום האחרון: אפגניסטן, 14.
ובכנות: האמירויות וסעודיה רק 4 נקודות מאחור.
לא מושלמים. אבל מסכנים? הכי קרובים לאושר באזור.

Sources: World Happiness Report 2026; OECD 2025; National Insurance Institute.

sources.label: World Happiness Report (Gallup World Poll, 2023 to 2025)

lines.line: This is a perfectly happy life. Israel is here.
Seventy-two out of a hundred. The eighth happiest country on Earth.
What's in the gap? Prices: fourth highest of thirty-eight rich countries.
And the war. Israel was fifth in twenty twenty-four. Now it's eighth.
Now zoom out. They think Israelis must be miserable.
Miserable looks like this: Afghanistan, last in the world, at fourteen.
The Emirates and Saudi Arabia, sixty-eight. Kuwait, sixty-five. Turkey, fifty-three. Iran, fifty-two. Jordan, forty-five. Egypt, thirty-nine.
Every neighbour is further from a happy life.
One honest catch: the Emirates and Saudi Arabia are only four points behind.
We're not perfect. We know it.
But miserable? We're closer to a happy life than anyone around us.
